nodes.label: The brief wins

nodes.label: Refinement preserves, redesign replaces
nodes.rationale: Never split the difference into polish on a discarded look; redesign treats the old look as evidence and anti-reference.

nodes.label: Operate visitor mode
nodes.rationale: The visitor came to get a job done, so the page is first a working product of its category and the world serves it.

nodes.label: Signature move
nodes.rationale: One concrete named move (e.g. service health as a transit map); a world that shows up only as colour scheme has not found its move.

nodes.label: Single-object rule
nodes.rationale: When the world is an object, the page is one object at one scale and point of view, keeping its real form.

nodes.label: Persuade and Experience visitor modes
nodes.rationale: The design is what the visitor judges, so the world may own and structure the page.

nodes.label: Read visitor mode
nodes.rationale: The visitor came to understand something; the page is first a document of its kind, framed by the world.

nodes.label: Code-led build
nodes.rationale: Ambition lives in the contract's FIRST VIEWPORT block and signature interaction, audited at finish.

nodes.label: Concept-seed roll (three dealt structures)
nodes.rationale: Dice pick which structures reach the user, breaking the ranking rut while keeping a real choice.

nodes.label: Direction contract

nodes.label: Surface brief
nodes.rationale: Keeps strategy that belongs to one route or artifact; does not copy product truth or DESIGN.md tokens.

nodes.label: Visual world

nodes.label: Region map (regions.json)

nodes.label: ANIMATION.md Project Rules File
nodes.rationale: Project rules outrank the skill; if a project rule looks wrong say so rather than silently following the skill.

nodes.label: ScrambleTextPlugin
nodes.rationale: Unreadable while running; keep under ~1.2s; Persian/Arabic scramble badly due to contextual glyphs.

nodes.label: SplitText Plugin (mask lines, autoSplit)
nodes.rationale: mask:'lines' makes lines rise out of nothing; autoSplit re-splits on font load/resize; always revert on unmount.

nodes.label: Stagger Rhythm (each vs amount)
nodes.rationale: Beyond ~8 items stagger a total amount so lists don't take seconds.

nodes.label: GSAP Transform Replaces CSS Transform
nodes.rationale: Inline GSAP matrix outranks class transforms including rtl: variants, breaking mirroring in one direction only.

nodes.label: Deriving Rules Without a File (lint, colour, direction, house language)
nodes.norm_label: deriving rules without a file (lint, colour, direction, house language)

nodes.label: Templates Under Dot-Directories Are Not Typechecked
nodes.norm_label: templates under dot-directories are not typechecked

nodes.label: Motion Budget
nodes.rationale: A page gets busy one reasonable addition at a time; a budget makes cost visible, and going over needs a stated reason.

nodes.label: Pattern Maturity Model (experimental/candidate/validated/canonical/retired)
nodes.rationale: A pattern loaded as guidance repeats every session, so status must be evidence, never a claim; the skill never changes a status on its own.

nodes.label: RTL Mirroring of Handed Motion
nodes.rationale: GSAP transforms are physical; read dir off the document rather than importing a locale so the hook stays i18n-independent; Flip needs nothing.

nodes.label: Waivers Carry Reasons (rule-id-ok)
nodes.rationale: A bare waiver token is a rule switched off rather than answered.

nodes.label: Stop After Three Rounds; Leave What Works Alone
nodes.norm_label: stop after three rounds; leave what works alone
nodes.rationale: Prevents trying a fourth shape of the same idea and churn (outcome-no-churn eval).

nodes.label: SVG Colours: currentColor and Unstable Export Class Names
nodes.norm_label: svg colours: currentcolor and unstable export class names

nodes.label: Copy Passed as Prop
nodes.rationale: A client component importing messages can bundle every locale into the browser payload.

nodes.label: Line Mask Without SplitText
nodes.rationale: Cheaper and no revert to forget when markup is controlled.

nodes.label: Lines vs Words vs Chars
nodes.rationale: Per-char paragraph reveals are unreadable and create hundreds of nodes.

nodes.label: overwrite: "auto"
nodes.rationale: Fixes the hover bug where fast leave/re-enter leaves an element halfway.

nodes.label: gsap.quickTo / quickSetter
nodes.rationale: One retargeted tween per high-frequency event avoids garbage allocation and fighting tweens; the single most important performance tool for pointer work.

nodes.label: Magnetic Element
nodes.rationale: Strength 0.2-0.4; measure rect in handler; padded hit area makes the pull feel like a field.

nodes.label: Loader/Artwork Announcement (role=status vs aria-hidden)
nodes.rationale: An sr-only label inside aria-hidden is dead markup; never both.

nodes.label: Current-State Marker Contrast (WCAG 1.4.11 + aria-current)
nodes.rationale: Brand tints rarely hit 3:1, so state is carried also in the label colour and aria-current.

nodes.label: Gate Hover on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)
nodes.norm_label: gate hover on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)
nodes.rationale: On touch, :hover sticks after a tap and never clears.

nodes.label: matchMedia Requires Both Motion Conditions
nodes.rationale: Callback runs only while a named condition matches; with only 'reduced', no-preference visitors match nothing and the page ships with no animation silently (audit rule matchmedia-never-runs).

nodes.label: Reduced Branch Must Set End State
nodes.norm_label: reduced branch must set end state
nodes.rationale: A from tween that never runs leaves the element at its authored start (invisible) - the most common reduced-motion bug, hiding content.

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Is a Design
nodes.rationale: prefers-reduced-motion users suffer vestibular triggers (large travel, parallax, zoom, spin, uninitiated motion); the question is how to say what the motion said without travel, not whether to animate.

nodes.label: Full / Light / Static Beat Versions
nodes.rationale: The device changes the technique, never the story; only branch device-sensitive techniques to avoid two motion languages.

nodes.label: Input -> Response -> Recovery
nodes.rationale: Recovery (easing back) is what makes interaction feel physical.

nodes.label: Layer Follows the Pointer on Both Axes
nodes.norm_label: layer follows the pointer on both axes
nodes.rationale: In blind judging a card that followed beat one that drifted away; depth comes from how far, not which way.

nodes.label: Measured Marker Needs Physical Anchor
nodes.rationale: offsetLeft and x are physical; inset-inline-start resolves to right on RTL and misplaces the marker.

nodes.label: Tweening Timeline Progress to Smooth External Values
nodes.norm_label: tweening timeline progress to smooth external values

nodes.label: Pinning
nodes.rationale: overflow:hidden ancestor breaks pin; position:sticky is cheaper when no timeline is driven.

nodes.label: ScrollSmoother
nodes.rationale: A large commitment that takes over the scroll container; add only when the whole page is designed around smoothed scrolling.

nodes.label: Scrubbing a Paused Timeline via Progress Tween
nodes.norm_label: scrubbing a paused timeline via progress tween

nodes.label: Subpath Plugin Imports and registerPlugin
nodes.rationale: Import each plugin from its own subpath (never gsap/all) so bundlers drop unused ones; registering useGSAP makes GSAP warn about missing plugins.

nodes.label: GSAP Bundle Size and Subpath Loading
nodes.norm_label: gsap bundle size and subpath loading

nodes.label: Frame Budget at 60/120/165Hz
nodes.rationale: GSAP drives at display rate, so 165Hz leaves 6.2ms; 60Hz is the wrong design target in both directions.

nodes.label: Measure in Milliseconds, Not Frames
nodes.rationale: A fixed frame count is a different duration on every display.

nodes.label: top:50% vs yPercent Swap Asymmetry
nodes.rationale: top % is of the containing block; yPercent is of the element itself, so a 1px rule's travel collapses.

nodes.label: State Owns What Exists, GSAP Owns How It Moves
nodes.norm_label: state owns what exists, gsap owns how it moves
nodes.rationale: Per-frame React state re-renders the whole subtree.

nodes.label: ScrollTrigger Cost Rules
nodes.rationale: One trigger per visual moment; scrub:1 batches into ticker, cheaper than scrub:true.

nodes.label: Wait in rAF Frames, Not setTimeout
nodes.norm_label: wait in raf frames, not settimeout
nodes.rationale: Automation/background tabs throttle rAF while setTimeout fires, so gsap.to looks frozen; a misdiagnosed StrictMode revert bug was undone once tests waited in frames.

nodes.label: One Trigger, Many Elements
nodes.rationale: Per-card triggers each carry scroll maths; a grid on one screen is one staggered trigger.

nodes.label: Trigger vs Playhead (scrub with ease none)
nodes.norm_label: trigger vs playhead (scrub with ease none)
nodes.rationale: Easing inside a scrubbed timeline fights the visitor's scroll and reads as lag.

nodes.label: Pause off-screen loops via ScrollTrigger onToggle
nodes.norm_label: pause off-screen loops via scrolltrigger ontoggle

nodes.label: Seamless marquee (duplicate copy, function x, width-derived duration)
nodes.norm_label: seamless marquee (duplicate copy, function x, width-derived duration)

nodes.label: Duration Bands
nodes.rationale: Distance buys time; exits are 60-70% of entrances.

nodes.norm_label: five purposes of motion (hierarchy, causality, continuity, state, personality)
nodes.rationale: Every animation must answer one of these or be deleted.

nodes.norm_label: reading a request: intent to values table
nodes.rationale: Feelings (cinematic, premium, playful, alive, technical, organic) resolve to duration, ease, competing count, what stays still; they compose one column at a time.

nodes.label: audit Command
nodes.rationale: Run the deterministic checker first; when an animation is invisible ask whether it was ever built.

nodes.label: create / design / build Commands
nodes.rationale: Separated so disagreement about the idea surfaces in a cheap plan, not in code.

nodes.label: Reference Load Map

nodes.norm_label: something crazy: one concept, three techniques

nodes.norm_label: technique ladder (css transition -> tween -> timeline -> plugin -> scroll takeover)

nodes.label: Config drift detection

nodes.label: Dev-only CSP allowance patch (localhost:8400)
nodes.rationale: Guarded by NODE_ENV development so production CSP is never weakened; requires explicit user consent.

nodes.norm_label: mount/revert on router swap events (turbo, htmx)

nodes.label: Per-instance plugin ids via useId()
nodes.rationale: Scope does not reach plugin config (motionPath.path, morphSVG.shape) which resolves document-wide; hardcoded ids make instances drive the first one's geometry.

nodes.label: Never Read Media Queries During Render
nodes.norm_label: never read media queries during render
nodes.rationale: Servers have no viewport or pointer, so branching before mount causes hydration mismatches.

nodes.label: Start Safe, Then Enhance; Downgrade Once
nodes.norm_label: start safe, then enhance; downgrade once
nodes.rationale: Shipping the expensive version first sends it to the least capable device; re-sampling frame rate spends budget on flipping.

nodes.label: Simulator screenshot verification (xcrun simctl)
nodes.rationale: Screenshots come from the Simulator, never a browser; hardware needed for posture, gestures, performance.

nodes.label: Full interactive state set
nodes.rationale: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error on every interactive component.

nodes.label: Critique snapshot backlog (critique-storage)
nodes.rationale: Polish reads the latest snapshot and closes only the snapshot it actually processed.

nodes.label: Drift classification (missing token, one-off, conceptual mismatch, local defect)
nodes.norm_label: drift classification (missing token, one-off, conceptual mismatch, local defect)
nodes.rationale: Fix the cause at the narrowest correct level.

nodes.label: Polish triage order
nodes.rationale: Functional defects before cosmetic; do not perfect one corner while the rest lags.

nodes.label: Context-aware no-argument menu
nodes.rationale: Never auto-run a command; lead with 2-3 picks reasoned from signals.

nodes.label: Typographic role system
nodes.rationale: Use the fewest roles and families that make hierarchy unmistakable; 45-75ch measure, 16px body floor.

nodes.label: iOS slop test (ported-from-a-website tell)
nodes.rationale: Fluent iPhone users distrust off-spec controls; default to platform components and depart only for a reason the user would thank you for.

nodes.label: Time to value / aha moment
nodes.rationale: Onboarding's job is to reach the moment that proves the product is worth the time, not to teach everything.

nodes.label: Product slop test (earned familiarity)
nodes.rationale: Product UI fails through strangeness without purpose; the tool should disappear into the task.

nodes.label: Quiet design through precision
